abilities.name: synchronize
abilities.effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

kanto.flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

original-johto.flavorText: Because it can learn any move, some people began research to see if it is the ancestor of all POKéMON.

hoenn.flavorText: A MEW is said to possess the genes of all POKéMON. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

original-unova.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

updated-unova.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

kalos.flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Mew is said to possess the genetic composition of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
